description: Which of several parallel attempts is the best one: the host's explicit pick when it names one, otherwise the highest score that is actually a score. The rule is one pure function so the column surface, its comparison table and a test can never disagree about who won. It is deliberately conservative: an unscored attempt never wins on a comparison scale nobody set (its null is "not scored", not "zero"), an attempt still running never wins over a finished one with the same score, and a named attempt wins even when it has no score — the host may know something the numbers do not.
usageExample:
var best = ParallelAttemptRanking.Best(attempts);          // highest score
var picked = ParallelAttemptRanking.Best(attempts, "c");     // the host's pick wins
var ordered = ParallelAttemptRanking.Order(attempts);        // best first, the rest stable

members.name: Best
members.description: Resolves the best attempt out of attempts.
